definitions.explanation: Lacking care or attention to detail. Describes work, behavior, or handling that is done carelessly or without proper effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{雑|ざつ}だ。
⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{雑|ざつ}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧んだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: It broke because you handled it so roughly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{雑|ざつ}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: She has a cheerful personality, but she does things so carelessly that she sometimes causes trouble for those around her.

notes:
USAGE:
{雑|ざつ} is very common in everyday speech. It is a na-adjective that describes the quality of someone's work, handling, or approach as lacking attention and care. It is always negative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{雑|ざつ} (work is sloppy)
- ⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{雑|ざつ} (handling is rough)
- {雑|ざつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (to do something carelessly)
- {雑|ざつ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (careless personality)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雑|ざつ}: rough, sloppy (lacking care and attention)
- ⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧: halfhearted, not serious (also means "appropriate" in other contexts)
- ⟦{大雑把|おおざっぱ}→大雑把：06867_oozappa⟧: rough, broad-strokes (less negative; can mean "big-picture oriented")
